"""Compile an admitted native project in a NEW isolated output, never its Makefile.

This is source/ABI/closure validation, not a Ground runtime adapter or hardware
acceptance. The descriptor is supplied by the trusted operator, outside input.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

SCG=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(SCG/"src"))
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NativeDeviceFacts, NativeMemoryRegion, NativeClassicCdc_Inspect, NATIVE_PREFIX
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_machine_contract import NativeAssemblyDirectives_Validate, NativeArmAttributes_Validate, NativeIndependentVectors_Validate
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeHalDerivatives_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_clock import NativeClock_FilesRender, NativeClockSourceContract_Validate
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_ground import NativeGroundCandidate_Render


def NativeCompile_Run(args):
    root=args.input.resolve(); output=args.output.absolute()
    if output.exists() or output.resolve()!=output or output.is_relative_to(root) or root.is_relative_to(output):
        raise ValueError("new disjoint validation output required")
    if args.device_facts.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("trusted independent device descriptor must be outside the imported project")
    facts_json=json.loads(args.device_facts.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    facts=NativeDeviceFacts(**{**facts_json,"regions":tuple(NativeMemoryRegion(**r) for r in facts_json["regions"]),
        "irq_numbers":tuple(tuple(item) for item in facts_json.get("irq_numbers",[]))})
    proof,inventory,files=NativeClassicCdc_Inspect(root,device_facts=facts,spi_resource=args.spi,gpio_resources=tuple(args.gpio))
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    original_hashes={p:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p,b in files.items()}
    for p,b in files.items():
        dest=output/NATIVE_PREFIX/p; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(b)
    snapshot_modules=[Path(__file__),SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/hardware/native_classic_cdc.py",
        SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/hardware/native_machine_contract.py",
        SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/generator/native_hal.py",SCG/"src/silverstar_fccg/generator/native_clock.py"]
    if args.runtime_project is not None:
        snapshot_modules += [SCG/('src/silverstar_fccg/generator/'+name+'.py') for name in ('native_ground','native_platform','native_runtime')]
    (output/"source-snapshot.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "source_commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(SCG),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),
        "dirty_diff":subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(SCG),"diff","--binary"],text=True),
        "modules":{str(p.relative_to(SCG)):{"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  "source":p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")} for p in snapshot_modules},
        "input_sha256":original_hashes,"facts":facts_json},indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    tools=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_ground_0_1_0/payload/Tools"
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("native_dependency_contract",tools/"ground_artifact_contract.py")
    dependencies=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(dependencies)
    graph={**proof["build"],"sources":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["sources"]],
           "asm_sources":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["asm_sources"]],
           "include_dirs":[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof["build"]["include_dirs"]],
           "required_irq_handlers":proof["required_irq_handlers"],"linker_script":NATIVE_PREFIX+proof["build"]["linker_script"]}
    experiments={}
    experimental_files={}
    if args.runtime_project is not None:
        if args.clock_hz is None or args.reviewed_hal:
            raise ValueError('Private Ground candidate needs --clock-hz; HAL derivatives are included once')
        from silverstar_fccg.plugins.catalog import PluginCatalog
        from silverstar_fccg.project.model import ProjectModel_Load
        model=ProjectModel_Load(args.runtime_project)
        catalog=PluginCatalog(SCG/'plugins/builtin',SCG/'plugins/installed');catalog.Scan()
        experimental_files,graph,records=NativeGroundCandidate_Render(files,proof,inventory,model,catalog,hclk_hz=args.clock_hz)
        experiments['native_ground']=records
        experimental_files['candidate_config.ssproject']=args.runtime_project.read_bytes()
    elif args.reviewed_hal:
        derived,replacements,manifest=NativeHalDerivatives_Render(files,proof["build"]["sources"])
        experimental_files.update(derived)
        graph["sources"]=[replacements.get(p,p) for p in graph["sources"]]
        experiments["reviewed_hal"]=manifest
    if args.clock_hz is not None and args.runtime_project is None:
        experiments["clock"]=NativeClockSourceContract_Validate(files,proof["build"]["sources"],hclk_hz=args.clock_hz)
        experimental_files.update(NativeClock_FilesRender(hclk_hz=args.clock_hz))
        api=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_platform_api/payload/Platform/Inc"
        for path in api.glob("*.h"):
            experimental_files["Platform/Inc/"+path.name]=path.read_bytes()
        core=SCG/"plugins/builtin/silverstar_core_0_1_0/payload"
        for path in ("Common/Inc/silverstar_assert.h","Common/Inc/silverstar_compiler.h","Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c"):
            experimental_files[path]=(core/path).read_bytes()
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.multi_target import _UserSection_Insert
        main=files[proof["cdc"]["owners"]["main.c"]].decode("utf-8-sig")
        main=_UserSection_Insert(main,"Includes",'#include "native_clock.h"\n#include "platform_time.h"',empty=True)
        main=_UserSection_Insert(main,"2","  if (PlatformTime_Init() != PLATFORM_OK) { Error_Handler(); }",empty=True)
        loop=re.findall(r"/\* USER CODE BEGIN 3 \*/(.*?)/\* USER CODE END 3 \*/",main,re.S)
        if len(loop)!=1 or loop[0].strip()!="}" or main.count("HAL_Init();")!=1:
            raise ValueError("Unreviewed native main clock probe hook")
        main=main.replace("HAL_Init();","if (HAL_Init() != HAL_OK) { Error_Handler(); }",1)
        main=main.replace("/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */","/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */\n    uint64_t now_us;\n    if (NativeClock_Read(&now_us) != NativeClockResult_Ok) { Error_Handler(); }",1)
        main_path="HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeEntry/Core/Src/main.c"
        experimental_files[main_path]=main.encode("utf-8")
        graph["sources"]=[main_path if p==NATIVE_PREFIX+proof["cdc"]["owners"]["main.c"] else p for p in graph["sources"]]
        graph["sources"].extend([p for p in experimental_files if p.startswith("Generated/") and p.endswith(".c")])
        graph["sources"].append("Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c")
        graph["include_dirs"].extend(["Generated/Inc","Platform/Inc","Common/Inc"])
    for path,content in experimental_files.items():
        dest=output/path;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_bytes(content)
    compiler=args.toolchain_prefix+"gcc"
    environment=os.environ.copy()
    for name in ("CPATH","C_INCLUDE_PATH","CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH","OBJC_INCLUDE_PATH","DEPENDENCIES_OUTPUT","SUNPRO_DEPENDENCIES","GCC_EXEC_PREFIX","COMPILER_PATH"):
        environment.pop(name,None)
    commands=[]
    warning_diagnostics=[]
    log=output/"commands.log"

    def run(command):
        result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=output,env=environment,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
        with log.open("a",encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(command)+"\n"+result.stdout+"\nEXIT "+str(result.returncode)+"\n")
        commands.append({"command":command,"exit":result.returncode})
        warning_diagnostics.extend(line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if "warning:" in line)
        if result.returncode: raise ValueError("native validation command failed; see "+str(log))
        return result.stdout

    flags=[*graph["mcu_flags"],*["-I"+p for p in graph["include_dirs"]],*["-D"+d for d in graph["defines"]]]
    # Declarations must agree with actual headers, and the compiler must select
    # the expected Cortex/32-bit pointer ABI. This test source is never executed.
    core={"cortex-m0":0,"cortex-m0plus":0,"cortex-m3":3,"cortex-m4":4}[facts.core]
    tx_qualifier="const " if proof["spi_abi"]["tx_buffer_const"] else ""
    fpu_probe='_Static_assert(__FPU_PRESENT == 1U, "independent FPU facts must match native CMSIS");' if facts.fpu else ''

"""Effective ARM attribute and independent vector-slot checks, separate from text ownership."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import struct


def NativeAssemblyDirectives_Validate(text: str, *, core: str, fpu: str,
                                     reviewed_assert_trap: bool = False) -> None:
    arch = {"cortex-m0": "armv6-m", "cortex-m0plus": "armv6-m",
            "cortex-m3": "armv7-m", "cortex-m4": "armv7e-m"}[core]
    clean = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n]*|^[ \t]*@[^\r\n]*", "", text, flags=re.S | re.M)
    for kind, value in re.findall(r"(?<!\w)\.(cpu|arch|arch_extension|fpu)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+)", clean):
        value = value.lower()
        allowed = {"cpu": {core}, "arch": {arch}, "arch_extension": set(),
                   "fpu": {"softvfp", *([fpu] if fpu else [])}}[kind]
        if value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError("Native CPU directive contradicts independent device facts: ." + kind + " " + value)
    raw = list(re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)\.inst(?:\.[nw])?\b[^\r\n]*", clean))
    if raw:
        # GCC emits the established __builtin_trap as Thumb UDF #255 (0xdeff).
        # This exact opcode is available on all admitted M profiles. Only the
        # unchanged owned assertion unit can request this check; native startup
        # and arbitrary inline assembly cannot use it to bypass ISA validation.
        trap = re.search(r"(?ms)^SilverStarAssert_Fail:\s*\n(.*?)^[ \t]*\.size\s+"
                         r"SilverStarAssert_Fail\s*,", clean)
        if (not reviewed_assert_trap or trap is None or len(raw) != 1 or
                not trap.start(1) <= raw[0].start() < trap.end(1) or
                not re.fullmatch(r"\s*\.inst\s+0xdeff\s*", raw[0][0])):
            raise ValueError("Native raw instruction encoding requires a separately reviewed instruction contract")


def NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes: str, *, core: str, fpu: str, hard_float: bool,
                                 assembly: bool = False) -> None:
    tags = dict(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(Tag_\w+):\s*([^\r\n]+)", attributes))
    arch, thumb = {"cortex-m0": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m0plus": ("v6S-M", "Thumb-1"),
                   "cortex-m3": ("v7", "Thumb-2"),
                   "cortex-m4": ("v7E-M", "Thumb-2")}[core]
    profile = tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch_profile", "Microcontroller" if core in {"cortex-m0","cortex-m0plus"} else "")
    if (tags.get("Tag_CPU_arch") != arch or tags.get("Tag_THUMB_ISA_use") != thumb or
            profile != "Microcontroller"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM architecture attributes contradict independent core facts")
    if "Tag_ARM_ISA_use" in tags or "Tag_Advanced_SIMD_arch" in tags:
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires an unsupported instruction profile")
    if "Tag_FP_arch" in tags and (fpu != "fpv4-sp-d16" or tags["Tag_FP_arch"] != "VFPv4-D16"):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating attributes contradict independent FPU facts")
    if "Tag_ABI_HardFP_use" in tags and tags["Tag_ABI_HardFP_use"] != "SP only":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM object requires unsupported floating instructions")
    arguments = tags.get("Tag_ABI_VFP_args")
    if (arguments is not None and arguments != "VFP registers") or (arguments is not None and not hard_float):
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM floating calling ABI contradicts native contract")
    if hard_float and not assembly and arguments != "VFP registers":
        raise ValueError("Actual ARM C/ELF lacks its required hard-float calling ABI")


def NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector: bytes, symbols: str, slots: dict[str, int]) -> None:
    entries = {name: (int(address, 16), kind) for address, kind, name in
               re.findall(r"(?m)^([0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(\w)\s+(\w+)$", symbols)}
    if not slots:
        raise ValueError("Independent IRQn slots are missing")
    for handler, irqn in slots.items():
        if handler not in entries or entries[handler][1] != "T":
            raise ValueError("Independent IRQn has no strong compiled handler: " + handler)
        offset = (irqn + 16) * 4
        if (offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(vector) or
                struct.unpack_from("<I", vector, offset)[0] != (entries[handler][0] | 1)):
            raise ValueError("Actual vector contradicts independent IRQn binding: " + handler)

import. This renderer adds SCG owners without selecting an MCU-family backend.

reviews; a successful private compilation must not claim runtime qualification.

def _Function_Replace(source, name, replacement):
    start, _opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(source, name)
    return source[:start] + replacement + source[end:]


def _Callback_Integrate(source: str, indexed: bool) -> str:
    visible = NativeC_VisibleGet(source)
    names = ['CDC_Init_FS','CDC_DeInit_FS','CDC_Control_FS','CDC_Receive_FS']
    if indexed:
        names.append('CDC_TransmitCplt_FS')
    initializer = re.findall(r'USBD_CDC_ItfTypeDef\s+USBD_Interface_fops_FS\s*=\s*\{([^{}]*)\}\s*;',visible)
    if (len(initializer) != 1 or re.fullmatch(r'\s*'+r'\s*,\s*'.join(names)+r'\s*,?\s*',initializer[0]) is None or
            re.search(r'(?m)^\s*#\s*(?:define|undef)\b',visible) or '\\\n' in source or '\\\r\n' in source):
        raise ValueError('Native CDC initializer needs exact literal callback owners without expressions/aliases')
    # Existing application data hooks must be stock empty CubeMX policy.
    for name, expected in (
            ('CDC_Init_FS','USBD_CDC_SetTxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS,UserTxBufferFS,0);USBD_CDC_SetRxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS,UserRxBufferFS);return(USBD_OK);'),
            ('CDC_DeInit_FS','return(USBD_OK);'),
            ('CDC_Receive_FS','USBD_CDC_SetRxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS,&Buf[0]);USBD_CDC_ReceivePacket(&hUsbDeviceFS);return(USBD_OK);')):
        _start, opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(source, name)
        if re.sub(r'\s+','',NativeC_VisibleGet(source[opening+1:end-1])) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Native CDC refuses a nonempty/unreviewed data hook: '+name)
    source = source.replace('#include "usbd_cdc_if.h"','#include "usbd_cdc_if.h"\n#include "pc_byte_stream.h"',1)
    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_Init_FS','''static int8_t CDC_Init_FS(void)
{
  PcByteStream_OnUsbReset();
  if ((USBD_CDC_SetTxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS, UserTxBufferFS, 0U) != USBD_OK) ||
      (USBD_CDC_SetRxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS, UserRxBufferFS) != USBD_OK)) { return USBD_FAIL; }
  return USBD_OK;
}''')
    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_DeInit_FS','''static int8_t CDC_DeInit_FS(void)
{ PcByteStream_OnUsbReset(); return USBD_OK; }''')
    source = _Function_Replace(source,'CDC_Receive_FS','''static int8_t CDC_Receive_FS(uint8_t *Buf, uint32_t *Len)
{
  uint8_t result;
  if ((Buf == NULL) || (Len == NULL) || (*Len > 64U)) { return USBD_FAIL; }
  PcByteStream_OnUsbReceive(Buf, (uint16_t)*Len);
  result = USBD_CDC_SetRxBuffer(&hUsbDeviceFS, Buf);
  if (result == USBD_OK) { result = USBD_CDC_ReceivePacket(&hUsbDeviceFS); }
  if (result != USBD_OK) { PcByteStream_OnUsbReset(); }
  return (int8_t)result;
}''')
    return source

    main_path = proof['cdc']['owners']['main.c']
    main = native_files[main_path].decode('utf-8-sig')
    main = _UserSection_Insert(main,'Includes','#include "native_runtime.h"',empty=True)
    main = _UserSection_Insert(main,'2','  if (NativeRuntime_Init() != NativeRuntimeResult_Ok) { Error_Handler(); }',empty=True)
    loop = re.findall(r'/\* USER CODE BEGIN 3 \*/(.*?)/\* USER CODE END 3 \*/',main,re.S)
    if len(loop) != 1 or loop[0].strip() != '}' or main.count('HAL_Init();') != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native main requires empty stock owner loop and one HAL initialization')
    main = main.replace('HAL_Init();','if (HAL_Init() != HAL_OK) { Error_Handler(); }',1)
    main = main.replace('/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */','''/* USER CODE BEGIN 3 */
    NativeRuntimeResult result = NativeRuntime_Process();
    if ((result != NativeRuntimeResult_Ok) && (result != NativeRuntimeResult_RadioFailure) &&
        (result != NativeRuntimeResult_PcFailure)) { Error_Handler(); }
    /* Ordinary PC/radio failure diagnostics remain owned by Ground; retry in
     * the next bounded owner iteration. Clock/platform faults stop this loop. */''',1)
    main_owned = 'HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeEntry/'+main_path
    files[main_owned] = main.encode()
    replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+main_path] = main_owned
    callback = proof['cdc']['owners']['usbd_cdc_if.c']
    callback_owned = 'HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeData/'+callback
    files[callback_owned] = _Callback_Integrate(native_files[callback].decode('utf-8-sig'),indexed).encode()
    replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+callback] = callback_owned
    conf = proof['cdc']['owners']['usbd_conf.c']
    conf_owned = 'HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeData/'+conf
    conf_source = native_files[conf].decode('utf-8-sig')
    conf_source = _UserSection_Insert(conf_source,'Includes','#include "pc_byte_stream.h"',empty=True)
    for event in ('Reset','DevDisconnected','Suspend'):
        pattern = r'(?m)^([ \t]*)(USBD_LL_'+event+r'\([^\r\n]+\);)[ \t]*\r?$'
        conf_source,count = re.subn(pattern,r'\1PcByteStream_OnUsbReset();\n\1\2',conf_source)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('Native USB lifecycle owner is unknown: '+event)
    files[conf_owned] = conf_source.encode()
    replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+conf] = conf_owned
    sources = [replacements.get(NATIVE_PREFIX+p,NATIVE_PREFIX+p) for p in proof['build']['sources']]
    sources.extend(p for p in files if p.endswith('.c') and p.startswith(('Generated/','Common/')))
    for owner in (core,radio):
        sources.extend(p for p in owner.build.sources if '/Adapter/' not in p and p in files)
    includes = [NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof['build']['include_dirs']]
    includes.extend(['Generated/Inc','Common/Inc','Interfaces/Inc','Platform/Inc'])
    includes.extend(p for owner in (core,radio) for p in owner.build.include_dirs if '/Adapter/' not in p)
    graph = {**proof['build'],'sources':list(dict.fromkeys(sources)),
        'asm_sources':[NATIVE_PREFIX+p for p in proof['build']['asm_sources']],
        'include_dirs':list(dict.fromkeys(includes)),
        'defines':list(dict.fromkeys([*proof['build']['defines'],'SILVERSTAR_AIR_LINK_ENABLED=1','AIR_LINK_HAL_BUFFER_SIZE=260'])),
        'linker_script':NATIVE_PREFIX+proof['build']['linker_script'],
        'required_irq_handlers':proof['required_irq_handlers']}
    absent = [path for path in (*graph['sources'],*graph['asm_sources']) if path not in files and path.removeprefix(NATIVE_PREFIX) not in native_files]
    if absent:
        raise ValueError('Native candidate source graph is not closed: '+', '.join(absent))
    records = {'format_version':1,'clock':clock,'platform':platform,'hal':hal,'source_replacements':replacements,
        'original_sha256':{path:hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() for path,content in native_files.items()},
        'ep0_review':'NOT PROVEN: shared owner patch independent review blocked; no EP0 repair integrated',
        'critical_contract_review':'NOT PROVEN: USB bulk LL/class init/rearm error propagation needs completion; complete stack/WCET/hardware unavailable',
        'publication':'PRIVATE CANDIDATE ONLY; normal generation remains blocked'}
    files['Generated/native_ground_contract.json'] = json.dumps(records,indent=2).encode()
    files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json'] = json.dumps(graph,indent=2).encode()
    files['Makefile'] = _Makefile_Render(tuple(graph['sources']),tuple(graph['asm_sources']),tuple(graph['include_dirs']),
        tuple(graph['defines']),SimpleNamespace(**graph),ground.build.toolchain_prefix).encode()
    return files,graph,records
